lines.cyr: Коња спремам, песни пеам, на пат ќе одам,
lines.lat: Konja spremam, pesni peam, na pat ḱe odam,
lines.en: I prepare a horse, I sing songs, I will go on my way,

lines.cyr: на Илинден, Мечкин Камен, да се поклонам.
lines.lat: na Ilinden, Mečkin Kamen, da se poklonam.
lines.en: on Ilinden1, Mechkin Kamen2, to bow down.

lines.cyr: Кај што четата на Питу славно загина
lines.lat: Kaj što četata na Pitu slavno zagina
lines.en: Where Pitu's company gloriously died
for the defense of the Krushevo Republic.
Glory, glorious heroes,
for you died bravely

lines.cyr: и ден денес да ве славиме
lines.lat: i den denes da ve slavime
lines.en: and today let us celebrate you
on Ilinden, glorious Krushevo.
In 1903, on Ilinden,
you raised your head in the midst of the empire.
Ten days of the republic, in the midst of the Balkans,

lines.cyr: цело царство се затресе, царот побесне.
lines.lat: celo carstvo se zatrese, carot pobesne.
lines.en: the entire empire shook, the emperor went mad.
Glory, glorious heroes,
for you died bravely

lines.cyr: и ден денес да ве славиме
lines.lat: i den denes da ve slavime
lines.en: and today let us celebrate you
on Ilinden, glorious Krushevo.

lines.cyr: Гоце Делчев, Даме, Карев, Питу, Сандански,
lines.lat: Goce Delčev, Dame, Karev, Pitu, Sandanski,
lines.en: Goce Delchev, Dame, Karev, Pitu, Sandanski3,

lines.cyr: нека ви е вечна слава за сѐ што сторивте.
lines.lat: neka vi e večna slava za sè što storivte.
lines.en: may you have eternal glory for everything you have done.

lines.cyr: По затвори, по планини младост минавте,
lines.lat: Po zatvori, po planini mladost minavte,
lines.en: You have spent your youth in prisons and across mountains,

lines.cyr: за слобода на родна земја Македонија.
lines.lat: za sloboda na rodna zemja Makedonija.
lines.en: for the freedom of your native land Macedonia.
Glory, glorious heroes,
bravely you died

lines.cyr: и ден денес да ве славиме
lines.lat: i den denes da ve slavime
lines.en: and today let us celebrate you
on Ilinden, glorious Krusevo.
